thread:
Lena (Docs): Heads-up: I'm doing a sweep of doc PRs for inconsistent terminology. Noticed `model`, `model_variant`, `release` all used to mean slightly different things. Can we decide canonical words so snippets are consistent?
Marco (Eng): Yeah saw that too. Backend uses `model_id` and `variant_tag`. We should pick one canonical pair and migrate examples.
Aisha (PM): We need a short migration note we can link in the changelog. Timeline: before next SDK publish.
Lena (Docs): Draft suggestion: use `model_family` (human-facing), `model_id` (identifier used in APIs), and `variant` (quantization/size). Avoid `release` for routine updates; reserve for major, customer-visible releases.
Marco (Eng): That mapping works. For server code we can accept `model` as alias but emit deprecation warning.
DevEx (bot): Quick scan result: 37 example files reference `model:` in JS snippets. See https://go/repo/changeset/scan-2123
Lena (Docs): I'll update the glossary entry for `variant` and add a short section in the style guide: "Prefer explicit terms: `model_family` / `model_id` / `variant`." Also include example migration snippets.
Marco (Eng): Example change for SDK docs:
```js
// old
const out = client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b' })
// new
const out = client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood-7b', variant: 'v7-quant' })
```
Aisha (PM): Deprecation plan? Recommend: 14-day warning in logs, 8-week removal. We can be flexible for enterprise customers.
Lena (Docs): I'll add a migration section with both short and detailed examples and a snippet for the PR template: `NOTE: this PR updates examples to use model_id/variant; run link-check and snippets-lint.`
docs-lint-bot: Link checker: PR #4992 flagged -> missing anchor at /reference/glossary#variant (404).
Lena (Docs): I'll patch the glossary anchors and add redirects where possible. Also adding a small copy note: avoid referring to "the model" generically; prefer the concrete term.
Marco (Eng): I'll wire the server to log: "Deprecated param 'model' detected; use 'model_id' instead." Log level: INFO. I'll open server PR and update the client SDK examples in the same change set.
DevEx (bot): Suggested regex for bulk update: `rg "\\bmodel:\s*'[^']+'" -n | sed -E "s/model: /model_id: /"` (test first).
Lena (Docs): Action list: Lena -> glossary + style guide snippet + PR template text; Marco -> server warning + SDK example PR; Aisha -> finalize deprecation timeline and customer comms; DevEx -> run bulk example patch and open PRs.
Aisha (PM): Thanks everyone. Let's aim to have the migration note and patched examples merged  by next Tue. Ping me on the PR for review. :rocket:
Marco (Eng): On it.
Lena (Docs): Thanks all. I'll post a short follow-up once the glossary is updated.
